label: early copy step fed back e or 0 (rare conjunction)
explanation: Very sparse feature (about 0.004% of steps). 93% of its activation mass is in the copy phase at recall_idx 1-3, and about 77% is on steps whose fed-back input is e or 0, usually the second original token (prev2_tok = <DEL>). It never fires at t<4 or recall_idx>=4, and almost never in the original phase. That condition is only necessary, though: it holds on about 100k dev steps, of which only about 0.2% are active. Firing also depends on the surrounding tokens. First tokens j/u/0, outputs y/n/u/w/s/x and next outputs u/s/n/w raise the rate, but even the conjunction of all of these reaches only about 5% precision. The strongest examples are j/u/k followed by e/0 at step L+2. Activation is fairly uniform (median 0.116, max 0.191), and the specific magnitude drivers were not determined.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=e (+4.40), out_tok=y (+2.96), phase=2 & out_tok=n (+2.57), phase=2 & in_tok=0 (+2.48), orig3=i (+2.42), in_tok=0 (+2.39). Lower it: recall_idx=4 (-2.36), next_out=- (-2.27), to_go=1 (-2.07), orig8=- (-0.94).
